_note: This skill's checked-in routing corpus. NOTE: color-science is a REFERENCE skill — it ANSWERS color questions and points at a peer (ui-verify-color) for output; it does NOT generate palettes/tokens or grade on two axes. Its frontmatter uses ## Invocation + domain sections, not the decomposer template, but the corpus still applies: does the description route on real color questions and hold against siblings? Positives span the invocation families (color spaces/conversions, accessibility/contrast, palettes, CSS color, perception/CVD, naming, pigment/history) plus 2-3 indirect/symptom paraphrases. Negatives are drawn ADVERSARIALLY from real in-repo siblings — component-decomposer (web-component API/geometry, explicitly NOT color), layout-decomposer (UI structure), typography-lettering (the sister reference skill — type, not color) — plus GENERATE/grade requests that a builder or decomposer owns (a reference skill answers; it does not build a palette component, extract tokens, or grade two axes). IMPORTANT: routing-eval measures LEXICAL TOKEN OVERLAP only — it is a legibility aid, not a verdict. The indirect/symptom positives deliberately share few surface words and may score recall 0.000; that is a proxy limit (paraphrase-blindness), not a description defect. Re-derive when the neighbourhood changes.
